lines.text: How did your first cooking class go yesterday?
lines.speaker: Chen

lines.text: I was nervous at first. I didn't know anyone.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Did you cook by yourself in the class?
lines.speaker: Chen

lines.text: No, I worked with a woman at my table.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: What did the two of you make?
lines.speaker: Chen

lines.text: We made soup, and it tasted good in the end.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: So how did you feel after the class?
lines.speaker: Chen

lines.text: I was glad because I learned something new.
lines.speaker: Eli
